events.headline: US AI chip curbs threaten Southeast Asia data centre boom, shares slump
events.summary: New US restrictions on advanced chips and overseas compute access hit Southeast Asian data-centre firms, with some shares dropping nearly 20%. Operators serving Chinese clients face licensing, customer-verification and utilisation risks.

events.headline: US dollar hits 19-month peak on Fed hike bets, while NZ dollar slumps
events.summary: The dollar index reached 103.69 as markets priced a December Fed hike following stronger inflation. The New Zealand dollar fell to its lowest level since March 2020 amid tech-equity weakness.

events.headline: Developing economies risk missing out on defence and AI boom, EBRD warns
events.summary: The EBRD warned that weak infrastructure and financing could exclude many developing economies from AI and defence investment. Almost half its member economies lack grids capable of supporting even one data centre, while drone startups offer a growth opportunity.

events.headline: Baidu CEO says AI investment must deliver profits to avoid bubble
events.summary: Baidu CEO Robin Li warned that AI spending must produce measurable business profits to avoid bubble dynamics. He highlighted applications as the layer where AI investment must ultimately capture value.

events.headline: Shares slide on tech weakness ahead of Nvidia earnings
events.summary: Asian technology equities declined as US AI chip controls tightened and investors awaited Nvidia earnings. South Korean and Taiwanese indexes fell more than 2%, while higher US rate expectations supported the dollar.

events.headline: Reaction to US AI chip curbs that threaten data centre boom
events.summary: Analysts said US export controls could split cloud providers into trusted and higher-risk tiers, with new workload verification obligations. Projects dependent on Chinese tenants face licensing delays and reduced utilisation.

events.headline: APEC focuses on safe, responsible AI use, China's ex-UN envoy says
events.summary: APEC officials reported discussions on responsible AI deployment and the role of data in AI growth. Talks unfolded amid escalating US-China restrictions on remote access to advanced AI computing.

events.headline: Australia's TechnologyOne resists wave of AI job cuts to boost productivity
events.summary: Enterprise software maker TechnologyOne aims to double R&D output using AI with minimal headcount growth. It reported a 20% rise in annual pretax profit and charges a fixed price per AI interaction while routing among providers.

events.headline: Samsung Elec, TSMC shares fall after US announces curbs on China's chip access
events.summary: Samsung Electronics and TSMC shares declined after Washington tightened advanced-chip access restrictions. Analysts warned that foundries serving Chinese fabless companies could face extra licensing and due-diligence obligations.

events.headline: Popular websites subverted in bid to steal crypto, target iPhone users
events.summary: Researchers reported malicious third-party JavaScript injected into sites of 178 organisations through an optimisation platform. The code attempted cryptocurrency address substitution, card theft and iPhone exploitation; the extent of successful compromise remains unverified.

events.headline: Anthropic debuts to skeptics and dogged believers
events.summary: Reuters commentary examined Anthropic's upcoming IPO amid an AI equity selloff, highlighting long-term compute commitments and uncertain end-customer demand. The piece distinguishes strong infrastructure spending forecasts from realised application-level returns.
